messages:
olivia: Quick idea 30 show a tiny cost/latency badge in quicksearch results so engineers can spot expensive routes during discovery. avoid killing list perf, tho.
kevin: Per-route telemetry for every list row is scary. how many rows in quicksearch? 20-50? that  multiplies reads.
marta: We can keep it super lightweight: a cached compact telemetry blob (1m rollup) with a freshness indicator. fallback to 'est.' if not present. cache key per route_id.
ryan: UX flag 3 quicksearch is for fast discovery; adding numbers may be noise. keep a tiny icon or short token-cost label. tapping expands to fetch full details. mobile first.
olivia: yes. small badge + tooltip. click to open a detail panel that does an on-demand richer fetch. list render stays minimal.
sanjay: Ops considerations: each expand triggers telemetry reads. need per-user concurrency caps, RBAC checks, and quota accounting so automated searches don't cause storms.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/quicksearch-telemetry -> staging tests started (run b7c4).
marta: Implementation sketch: store compact telemetry in Redis per route updated every minute. key: telemetry:compact:{route_id} -> p50,p95,tokens_per_call_est,freshness. TTL 90s. list reads fetch that key.
kevin: API contract: only include telemetry when clients opt-in via ?includeTelemetry=compact. default false. also server-side feature flag for rollout.
olivia: Rollout plan: 5% orgs behind a "telemetry-preview" flag, with UI copy: "Sampled telemetry, may be delayed".
ryan: Saved queries: should we snapshot telemetry at save time? I think optional snapshot_id for reproducibility, but default should reference live telemetry. snapshots get stale.
sanjay: +1 for optional telemetry_snapshot metadata on saved queries. if provided, store iso timestamp.
marta: Concrete example to align formats:
```
{\n  "route_id": "r_123",\n  "name": "translate-en->es",\n  "compact_telemetry": {\n    "p50_ms": 36,\n    "tokens_per_call": 124,\n    "freshness_s": 42\n  }\n}
```
kevin: compact_telemetry must be optional. require clients to request it. prefer includeTelemetry=compact|full. budget payload ~1kb per result.
olivia: UX copy should surface sampling rate: "Telemetry sampled: 10% 3 may undercount token reads" to set expectations.
sanjay: Ops: enforce read concurrency limit (e.g., 50 simultaneous keys per user) and respond with 429 + Retry-After when exceeded. add Redis circuit-breaker for hot keys.
marta: For stats, store trimmed-mean p50/p95 to reduce outlier influence. pre-aggregate trimmed values.
kevin: I'll draft an API RFC describing payload, opt-in param, and fallback semantics.
olivia: Action items: marta -> build prototype compact telemetry cache and mock UI in staging; kevin -> API RFC + payload budget; sanjay -> quota/throttle proposal + k8s circuit-breaker config; ryan -> UX review when mocks ready. i'll draft rollout checklist and UX copy.
marta: ack, prototype link when ready: https://staging-console/quicksearch-telemetry
kevin: RFC incoming this afternoon.
ryan: Ping me for UX sign-off.
